memory.guest_scope: all guest DRAM reads; instruction, data, OS and ROS clients

telemetry.scope: Received completed updates; in-flight records at shutdown are excluded
telemetry.instrumentation: Per-update clock reads and small reliable ROS records; serialization/export follows the measured computation

coverage.scope: Matches independently received effort commands; does not prove delivery of every generated record

transport_latency.scope: Source publication to receiving RMW take (Fast DDS), or bridge ingress to destination publication (serialized bridge). Simulation time; host timestamps use coordinator boundary resolution. Missing receipts are censored at evaluation. The first take per source sample defines latency; additional duplicate/fanout takes are counted separately. Instrumentation adds clock/export work.

measurement_window: launch boundary to final evaluation; boundary quantization applies
